name: zinput_di_wait_for_button_press
description: zInput::DI_WaitForButtonPress polls joystick input until a button transition is found, resets transition state after each scan, and returns the 1-based button slot or zero for non-blocking calls.
known_limits: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4723d0 calls DI_PollJoystickState with pollUntilFound=true each iteration, scans joystick buttons 1 through 10, accepts DI_GetButtonTransitionState(button) == 1, calls DI_ResetTransitionState after each scan, repeats only when loopUntilPressed is nonzero, and returns the matching 1-based button slot or zero.

The existing zinput_joystick_poll_and_wait_smoke installs a fake joystick state, triggers a single button transition, verifies the returned 1-based slot, and observes callback dispatch through DI_PollJoystickState.

VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison for zinput_joystick_transition_wait passes for 0x4723d0 with zero unmasked mismatches after masking 12 relocation bytes and trimming 4 VC NOP bytes.
